name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=render/gfx, descriptor=party_status_overview_content). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately describes the function: it draws the entire static content (icon labels, chapter/turn/gold numbers, per-team alive counts, chapter title/subtitle) of the 'Army Status' overview panel into the supplied surface. Sole caller is fd2_open_party_status_overview_screen, the screen orchestrator, which delegates the content painting here -- name correctly distinguishes 'content' from the orchestration.
purpose: Draw the complete static content of the 'Army Status' overview panel (chapter/turn/gold/per-team alive counts/character-roster labels and the chapter title+subtitle text) onto a destination surface.
logic_summary: Blits four static icon-label sprites (0x85 chapter, 0x86 turn, 0x87 money, 0x88 roster) from the shared UI/anim sprite sheet at fixed offsets. Renders three numbers via fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer: chapter = current_chapter_id+1 (2-digit white 0x2A), turn = battle_turn_counter (3-digit white 0x2A), party gold (8-digit yellow 0x1F). Renders three per-team alive counts from fd2_count_active_chars_for_team_filter(0/2/1) (enemy/player/npc-ally, 2-digit each) along the same row (stride*0x9F). Computes chapter title text_id = current_chapter_id*2 + 0x255 and draws title and subtitle via fd2_display_dialog_scene. Mitti exception: when current_chapter_id == 0x10 (chapter 17) and fd2_check_party_has_char_id(0x12) == 0 (Mitti not recruited), text_id is decremented by 2 before the subtitle, so the subtitle uses the 'Mitti absent' variant. The binary reuses one register (EDI) for title id / optional -2 / +1 subtitle; mirrored here by mutating text_id in place.

params.name: dst_surface
params.semantics: Base linear address of the destination pixel surface. Caller passes panel_buf (off-screen) with stride 0x140, or data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr + 0x7964 (in-battle composite) with stride 0x1c8. All blit offsets are computed relative to this base.
params.reason: src declaration already names it dst_surface, which accurately reflects its role as the destination surface base; no address residue. (Ghidra decompiler shows generic param_1 but the src name governs.)

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Row pitch (bytes per scanline) of dst_surface. 0x140 (320) for panel_buf, 0x1c8 (456) for the in-battle composite. Used both as the row multiplier for vertical offsets and forwarded as the render pitch to the blit/number/dialog helpers.
params.reason: src declaration already names it stride, accurately describing the surface row pitch; no address residue. (Ghidra decompiler shows generic param_2 but the src name governs.)

returns.semantics: No return value; renders into dst_surface as a side effect.

data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id (0x53C03) -- current chapter id, drives chapter number, title text_id, and Mitti exception
data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (0x53BEF) -- turn count drawn as 3-digit number
data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold (0x53BF3) -- party gold drawn as 8-digit number
